rules.summary: Vacuous forwarding trampoline elimination guard: empty forwarding modules with ELOC <= 3 are strictly blocked
Substantive facade payload guard: facade module must satisfy ELOC >= 15 or aggregate >= 3 subdomains with immutability

File extension and directory classification guard: scripts and configs must reside in dedicated domain subdirectories matching their file extension (ps1, sh, py, common) and never litter the workspace root.
Pre-commit gate staged AST slice complexity (CC <= 15), nesting depth (Depth <= 4), and noise ratio guard

PowerShell block-chain guard: an else/elseif/catch/finally continuation must attach to a block that can legally accept it; a duplicated else branch parses with zero errors and only fails at run time on the branch that reaches it

Hardcoded scale count guard: an operator-facing success message must render its count from the measured data rather than embedding a literal, because a literal is a second source of truth that expires silently while the check keeps passing
Change Shannon entropy and diffusion guard: prevents chaotic cross-domain modifications exceeding cognitive budgets
Gate feedback vocabulary guard: operator-facing feedback must carry semantic step identifiers from the single-source registry and a closed four-state status vocabulary, never positional labels
Cross-platform script isomorphism guard: dual ps1/sh parity, strict CRLF/LF line endings, and defensive directives

Gate entry-point ordering guard: every helper a gate runner calls must be defined above the call site, because Bash and PowerShell resolve commands at execution time and an earlier call aborts the runner with a resolution error
Gate step registry binding guard: every step identifier referenced by a gate script must be declared in the single-source registry with a registered rule attribution
UTF-8 BOM hygiene guard: all workspace text files must be strictly UTF-8 NO-BOM without 0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF byte prefix
System and transient clutter guard: workspace must remain clean of OS clutter and uncontrolled transient files
Lingering empty directory guard: active source and tooling directories must not retain zero-file lingering empty folders
Comment-only hollow file guard: files whose stripped content is empty after removing comments are strictly blocked
Pure space indentation guard: non-GDScript and non-Makefile source files must use spaces exclusively without tab characters
POSIX EOF newline guard: text files must end with exactly one standard newline without trailing blank line buildup
Rule catalog counter coherence guard: totalRules must equal rules.length and the sum of deduplicated per-project counts
Logic density floor guard: effective code density must not fall below 33% of total file lines
High-load logic architecture contract guard: modules with ELOC >= 600 must maintain comment ratio >= 8%
Effective code volume budget guard: single file ELOC must not exceed 900
Physical line count budget guard: single file raw LOC must not exceed 1400
Dynamic dilution envelope guard: physical line count must not exceed dynamic ratio 1:3 envelope
Governance documentation scale figures must be rendered from their single source of truth; a hand-written count that no live source produces is rejected.
Linux command surface parity guard: every command promised by AGENTS.md must resolve to a working GNU binary or a declared PowerShell fallback on the current host.
